# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v4 c26 P4](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0004), [v4 c28 P3](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c31 P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia, Canada  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c27 P0](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004)</sub>; Mr. Robin Farrow  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a chubby boy with a round skull covered in fuzzy, bright yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose, blue eyes that dance with elfish roguishness, and a wide, smiling mouth with a single dimple on one cheek that gives him a mischievous look.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026)_

## Personality

Robin is a lively, mischievous, and inquisitive boy who is constantly getting into trouble and planning antics. He is open, affectionate, and bold, though he often acts without thinking and dislikes being restricted or told to stay still. He possesses a strong appetite and a persistent desire to learn about the world.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026)_

## History

Robin grew up in Nova Scotia as part of a large family with several sets of twins. After his mother passed away, he and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to live at Grey Shutters in Brierley. He quickly proved to be a handful, regularly indulging in pranks such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, pushing his sister into a pigpen, and placing a toad in Thirza's bed. Despite his mischief, he developed a deep affection for Nell Harcourt and Thirza. When he began attending Brierley school, he proved to be a lively student who formed strong friendships, particularly with Milty Gammon. He also enjoyed visiting his neighbor, Mr. Pettifer, and developed a fondness for farm chores, eventually aspiring to manage the farm himself. Upon learning of his uncle's death in British Columbia, he remained permanently in the care of Thirza at Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c8 P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c27 P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v3 c14 P14](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0014), [v3 c31 P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Born as one of three consecutive sets of twins to Mrs. Rudge in Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- His father passed away, leaving his mother in poor health before her death  <sub>[v2 c1 P34](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0034)</sub>
- Taken in by Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters following his mother's death  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)</sub>
